events.title: Agentic AI Shifts CPU-GPU Ratios, AMD Says
events.title_zh: AMD称，智能体AI正在改变CPU与GPU的比例
events.summary: AMD, Arm, and Microsoft have indicated that the rise of agentic AI is poised to significantly shift the traditional CPU-to-GPU ratios in data centers, potentially moving from a 1:4 ratio towards 1:1. This change is attributed to the increased CPU demand for orchestration, tool calls, and memory management inherent in agentic AI workloads.
events.summary_zh: AMD、Arm和Microsoft表示，智能体AI的兴起可能显著改变数据中心传统的CPU与GPU比例，可能从1:4转向1:1。这一变化源于智能体AI工作负载对编排、工具调用和内存管理提出了更高的CPU需求。
